clauses.clause: When this creature enters, creatures your opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: [cast] (cost B-3 W-3 = {3}{B}{B}{B}): opp_flier 1/1 and opp_bear 2/2 die, opp_giant 4/4 -> 2/2, opp_tapped 3/3 -> 1/1, your creatures unchanged; after the turn ends opp_giant and opp_tapped are back to 4/4 and 3/3. Same when it enters on the opponent's turn. Tree equal to parse template B2a-massacre-wurm. Pack massacre_wurm_minus_two_locked_set (a creature entering under the opponent's control later that turn is not affected) PASSES on the live tree and on this packet's tree.

clauses.clause: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, that player loses 2 life.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: two opposing deaths, two triggers, 'opp loses 2 life' twice, 20 -> 16. [an opponent's creature (opp_bear) dies]: trigger, opp 20 -> 18. [attacks and opp_giant blocks it]: opp_giant dies in combat, opp loses 2. [your creature (you_bear) dies]: no trigger. 'That player' is TARGET_PLAYER pre-bound to the dying creature (binding.py:1284), i.e. its controller. Tree equal to parse template B2b-massacre-wurm.
